title: Which edition did I match, and which citations survived?
title_en: Which edition did I match, and which citations survived?
abstract: A print book and a journal article led to different decisions in my religious studies bibliography. A four-link example shows what can still go wrong after a match.

history.note: First public methods note, with the four-link conversion example.

title: 教导有效，何以识别先知？
abstract: 安萨里如何从教导的效力辨认先知？这则札记比较《迷途指津》《圣学复苏》等文本，考察实践经验、历史传述与知识承继各能说明什么。
abstract_en: A reading of al-Ghazālī on what the efficacy of a teaching can establish about its teacher, and how the question changes when others inherit that knowledge.
